nodes.description: Owned.owner: contract owner address, read by _onlyOwner and written by acceptOwnership
Owned.nominatedOwner: pending ownership nominee, written by nominateNewOwner/acceptOwnership
AddressResolver.repository: mapping of bytes32 name to deployed address
MixinResolver.resolver: AddressResolver instance used for dependency lookups
Pausable.paused: global pause flag checked by the notPaused modifier
Pausable.lastPauseTime: timestamp of the most recent pause, assigned from now
Wrapper.token: underlying ERC20 collateral token backing the wrapper
Wrapper.currencyKey: synth currency key used for exchange rate valuation
Wrapper.synthContractName: resolver key of the synth the wrapper mints/burns
Wrapper.targetSynthIssued: running book value of synths that should be issued
WrapperFactory.CONTRACT_NAME: FlexibleStorage namespace and registration key prefix
Owned.acceptOwnership: nominee becomes owner after msg.sender check
Owned.nominateNewOwner: onlyOwner function setting the pending owner
Owned._onlyOwner: internal authorization check against msg.sender
Pausable.setPaused: onlyOwner pause toggle that records now as lastPauseTime
MixinResolver.rebuildCache: refreshes cached addresses from the resolver
WrapperFactory.createWrapper: onlyOwner deployment and registration of a Wrapper
WrapperFactory.distributeFees: forwards escrowed sUSD to the fee pool
WrapperFactory.isWrapper: view checking the registered wrapper version
WrapperFactory.feesEscrowed: sUSD balance held by the factory
Wrapper.mint: external notPaused/issuanceActive entry point minting synth for token
Wrapper.burn: external notPaused/issuanceActive entry point burning synth for token
Wrapper._mint: internal issuance, fee escrow and target state synchronisation
Wrapper._burn: internal burn, fee escrow and target state synchronisation
Wrapper._setTargetSynthIssued: writes targetSynthIssued and reports debt delta
Wrapper._safeTransferFrom: assembly based token transferFrom with gas forwarding
Wrapper.capacity: remaining token capacity before maxTokenAmount
Wrapper.totalIssuedSynths: USD valuation of targetSynthIssued
Wrapper.getReserves: token balance of the wrapper contract
Wrapper.calculateMintFee: computes mint fee and rebate sign
Wrapper.calculateBurnFee: computes burn fee and rebate sign
Wrapper.maxTokenAmount: reads configured wrapper token cap
Wrapper.mintFeeRate: reads configured mint fee rate
Wrapper.burnFeeRate: reads configured burn fee rate
Wrapper.issuanceActive modifier: requires SystemStatus issuance to be active
msg.sender: caller controlled address used for ownership checks, balances and issuance
block.timestamp (now): miner controllable timestamp stored into lastPauseTime
assembly call(gas(), token, ...) in _safeTransferFrom: raw external call with forwarded gas and no reentrancy guard
Wrapper constructor token.approve(address(this), uint256(-1)): unlimited self approval
synth().issue(msg.sender, amount): external synth mint during _mint
synth().burn(msg.sender, amount): external synth burn during _burn
synthsUSD().issue(wrapperFactory(), excessAmountUsd): external sUSD issuance to escrow fees
synthsUSD().transfer(feePool().FEE_ADDRESS(), amountSUSD): external token transfer
feePool().recordFeePaid(amountSUSD): external fee pool accounting call
debtCache().recordExcludedDebtChange(...): external debt cache mutation
flexibleStorage().setUIntValue(...): external storage write registering the wrapper version
wrapper.rebuildCache(): external call on the newly deployed wrapper contract
